title: A mainnet Soroban phase with three stages and two clusters in one stage
pattern: CAP-0063 parallel execution: the Soroban phase is stages of clusters of transactions. This mainnet ledger has 3 stages with 1, 2 and 1 clusters. Readers that assume one stage and one cluster drop transactions.

hazards.placement: ParallelTxsComponent with 3 stages, one holding 2 clusters
